title: Universal Life Insurance Surrender Charge Schedule by Tier
content:
Each Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance tier carries a surrender charge schedule stated in US dollars per $1000 of initial face amount, one rate for each policy year of the surrender charge period, and nothing after the schedule ends.

## Schedule of surrender charge rates (USD per $1000 of initial face)

| Policy year | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 35.00 | 28.00 | 24.00 | 30.00 | 26.00 | 22.00 |
| 2 | 33.00 | 25.00 | 21.00 | 27.00 | 24.00 | 20.00 |
| 3 | 31.00 | 22.00 | 19.00 | 24.00 | 22.00 | 18.00 |
| 4 | 29.00 | 19.00 | 17.00 | 21.00 | 20.00 | 16.00 |
| 5 | 27.00 | 16.00 | 15.00 | 18.00 | 17.00 | 14.00 |
| 6 | 25.00 | 13.00 | 12.00 | 15.00 | 14.00 | 11.00 |
| 7 | 22.00 | 10.00 | 9.00 | 12.00 | 11.00 | 8.00 |
| 8 | 19.00 | 7.00 | 6.00 | 9.00 | 8.00 | 6.00 |
| 9 | 16.00 | 4.00 | 3.00 | 6.00 | 5.00 | 4.00 |
| 10 | 13.00 | 2.00 | 1.00 | 3.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| 11 | 10.00 | none | none | none | none | none |
| 12 | 8.00 | none | none | none | none | none |
| 13 | 6.00 | none | none | none | none | none |
| 14 | 4.00 | none | none | none | none | none |
| 15 | 2.00 | none | none | none | none | none |
| Surrender charge years | 15 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

The rate for a policy year after the last listed year is zero: from policy year 16 on the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL and from policy year 11 on every other tier.

## Reading the schedule

- Policy year 1 runs from the issue date to the day before the first policy anniversary; each later policy year begins on a policy anniversary.
- The rate is applied per $1000 of the face amount at issue, so a $500000 initial face is 500 thousands.

## Hypothetical reading

An Ashgrove Accumulation UL policy with an initial face of $300000 (300 thousands) shows a schedule rate of 17.00 per $1000 in policy year 4 and 1.00 in policy year 10; in policy year 11 the schedule shows no rate. The same policy years on an Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL show 29.00, 13.00 and 10.00.
